name: Husky Pride Seattle 2024

venue.name: University of Washington, Oak Hall
venue.address: 4295 Little Canoe Channel NE, Seattle, WA 98195

information:
This is a fundraiser competition. Please visit the [fundraiser tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HuskyPrideSeattle2024#43506-fundraiser) for more information.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UWorUDont2023#34131-please-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab.
